task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A wide shot of a hazy, sunlit body of water with a distant city skyline and hills on the horizon, where several boats are moored on the left. The scene cuts to a large, white, two-deck passenger ferry with red life vests visible on the upper deck, moving from right to left across the water, creating a white wake. The ferry has text on its side, including "TURCO" and "KAPTAN SEBASTIAN". The view then shifts to the interior of a boat, looking out through a large opening at a group of six silhouetted people standing at a railing, looking out over the bright blue water and distant shoreline.
